title: II–III. Threefold use of the forensic law
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): Ye first use stands as gathered from Psalm 122:3-8. Ye second flows from God's will that His people share nothing needless with others (Ps. 2; Ezek. 34:23-24). As toward ye third, that whole Jewish state and kingdom shadowed Christ and His spiritual kingdom. In this respect ye forensic law also deserves toward be called a pedagogue toward Christ. — II–III. Its use stands as threefold: first, that ye Jewish people's whole state might be ordered by a norm belonging toward public equity and justice; second, that this people might be distinguished by this law from other peoples; third, that it looked toward future things and stood as a type.
pass_b_english: II–III. Its use is threefold: first, that the Jewish people's whole state might be ordered by a norm of public equity and justice; second, that this people might be distinguished by this law from other peoples; third, that it looked to future things and was a type.

The first use is gathered from Psalm 122:3-8. The second flows from God's will that His people share nothing needless with others (Ps. 2; Ezek. 34:23-24). As to the third, that whole Jewish state and kingdom shadowed Christ and His spiritual kingdom. In this respect the forensic law also deserves to be called a pedagogue to Christ.
source_text: II. Est vero etiam hic legis forensis observandus usus & abrogatio. III. Usus vero illius legis triplex est: primus, ut totus status populi Judaici certa norma publicae aequitatis & iustitiae ordinaretur; secundus, ut populus iste ab aliis populis etiam hac lege discriminaretur; tertius ad ea respexit quae futura erant, & fuit typus. Primus usus colligitur ex Ps. 122:3-8. Alter fluit ex eo quod Deus voluit populum suum nihil cum aliis commune habere ubi fieri poterat (Ps. 2; Ezek. 34:23-24). De tertio non est dubium quin totus status & regnum Judaicum Christum eiusque regnum spirituale adumbraverint. Hoc respectu lex forensis paedagogus ad Christum dici meretur.
